[EN] There's so many people, and so much to see!
[ES] ¡Hay tanta gente y tantas cosas que ver!

[EN] Siruna, could we go over there?
[ES] Siruna, ¿podríamos ir allí?

[EN] Maybe...we could just wait here until the floor isn't so crowded.
[ES] Tal vez... podríamos simplemente esperar aquí hasta que la pista no esté tan llena.
